rationale: The candidate has a readable single massing idea and a decent overall silhouette, but it is still basically a compact carved-ish block with very little public threshold behavior. Across the views it remains coherent, so it avoids fragmentation, yet the blue frontage is met by a sealed edge rather than a legible court, notch, or undercut. The top and opposite views confirm a simple profiled extrusion with modest bending, not a robust neighborhood-living ground condition. Because the program requires an active street edge and one clear public void/terrace, this does not pass program_fit_hard_pass. The strongest repair direction is to preserve the dominant bent mass while carving a real access-side void or court and keeping the upper body calm above it.
